_comment: Provider naming rules, shared by the Python validators in
helixsh.cloud_batch and the JavaScript ones in desktop/lib/helixsh.cjs.
The desktop app validates before calling the backend so a typo is a
message next to the field rather than a subprocess exit code, which means
the same rules are written twice. Both suites read this file, so the two
implementations cannot drift apart without a test failing.
